en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestoned square framed by historic multi‑storey buildings with shuttered windows. In the center stands a tall baroque column or monument surrounded by greenery. At the far side of the square a grand building with an arched gateway opens toward a street. On the hillside behind the square rises a clock tower on a wooded hill. The scene is quiet with only a few small figures walking. Printed caption text appears at the top left of the image.
